mapping.summary: Rule-based sales commission calculation, ledgers and payment to employees or vendors.
claims: Commission matrix rules by salesperson, customer group, state/country, dimensions, item category and posting groups
Unlimited rules can apply to each sales line
Rules have date ranges and min/max amounts for tiered commissions
Basis can be revenue, adjusted revenue, profit, cost-plus, actual cost or a custom formula
Pays commission to an employee or vendor, on invoicing or on customer payment
Splits commission across a sales team by percentage
Sales groups simplify tiers across salespeople
Pending commission recalculates as the open sales document changes
Commission journals become ledgers on posting, paid via a payment journal
Adds territory code to customers and sales documents for rules
